hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.vue|*.js|*.mjs|*.json) ( cd "$(dirname "$f")" && npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" ) ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */prisma/schema.prisma) ( cd "$(dirname "$f")/.." && npx --no-install prisma generate ) ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
